name: Membase
description: Your Membase account as the agent's memory: time-boxed recall before each turn, plus membase_search, membase_save (only when asked) and membase_profile tools. One API key is one person's memory.

apiKey.label: Membase API key
apiKey.help: A developer key from Connect > Developer keys in the Membase app (Read, or Read & write to save). Prefer a SecretRef or ${MEMBASE_API_KEY}; when unset the MEMBASE_API_KEY environment variable is used.

baseUrl.label: API base URL
baseUrl.help: Only for a self-hosted or local Membase server (membase --local serve).

container.label: Default Memory (container id)
container.help: Where membase_save writes when the model names no container, and the one Memory automatic recall searches. Leave empty to search every Memory the key reaches.

recallBudgetMs.label: Recall budget (ms)
recallBudgetMs.help: How long automatic recall may wait before the turn continues without memory. The first search after a quiet spell can take up to a minute.

autoRecall.label: Automatic recall
autoRecall.help: Search Membase with the user's message before each turn and add what it finds as context.

autoCapture.label: Save before compaction
autoCapture.help: Off by default. When on, before OpenClaw compacts a long session the agent is asked to save durable facts with membase_save.

allowSharedConversations.label: Read in shared conversations
allowSharedConversations.help: Off by default: Membase is used only in the owner's own direct conversations. When on, group chats and other senders can trigger recall and search (never saves).

apiKey.description: Membase developer key (mbk_...). Falls back to MEMBASE_API_KEY.

baseUrl.description: API base URL; defaults to MEMBASE_BASE_URL, then https://api.app.membase.com.

container.description: Default container id for saves and automatic recall.

recallBudgetMs.description: Time budget for automatic recall; on expiry the turn continues without memory.

autoRecall.description: Search Membase before each user turn and inject the passages as context.

autoCapture.description: Ask the agent to save durable facts with membase_save before compaction.

allowSharedConversations.description: Allow reads (never writes) in group chats and conversations with other senders.
